2829-4009-5660-6769.easyPrerequisites: Evolution Witness has a +1/+1 counter on it.
2829-4009-5660-6769.description:
Cast Mox Opal by paying its mana cost.
When Mox Opal enters, Surge Conductor triggers.
Holding priority, activate Mox Opal by tapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Mox Opal, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Ravager.
Resolve the Surge Conductor trigger, causing you to proliferate, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Mox Opal from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat

4247-7430--5.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability and Gorma trigger.
Resolve the Gorma ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Gorma.
Resolve the persist ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it and at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Gorma.
Remove a -1/-1 counter and a +1/+1 counter from that creature as a state-based action.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat

586-3497-4247-5258-5618.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

2111-2981-6792.description:
Activate Megatog by sacrificing Wingrattle Scarecrow
When Wingrattle Scarecrow dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Wingrattle Scarecrow enters, Mm'menon triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Wingrattle Scarecrow
Resolve the Megatog ability.
Repeat.

648-1880-4153--147.manaNeeded: {G}{G}{G}{U}{U}{U} plus enough mana to cast the kicker spell kicked and {G}{G}{G}{U}{U}{U} plus enough mana to cast the kicker spell kicked
648-1880-4153--147.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to leave the battlefield.
You have a card in hand with kicker or multikicker.
You have a way to cause a creature to leave the battlefield.
648-1880-4153--147.description:
Cast Body of Research by paying {G}{G}{G}{U}{U}{U}, creating a 0/0 Fractal creature token, then putting a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to your deck size.
Cause the Fractal to leave the battlefield.
Resourceful Defense triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters onto Hallar equal to the number the Fractal had.
Cast any kicker or multikicker spell with kicker by paying its mana cost plus its kicker cost.
Hallar triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself, then dealing damage equal to the number of +1/+1 counters on it to each opponent.
Cast Body of Research by paying {G}{G}{G}{U}{U}{U}, creating a 0/0 Fractal creature token, then putting a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to your deck size.
Cause the Fractal to leave the battlefield.
Resouceful Defense triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Hallar equal to the number the Fractal had.
Cast any kicker or multikicker spell with kicker by paying its mana cost plus its kicker cost.
Hallar triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself, then dealing damage equal to the number of +1/+1 counters on it to each opponent.

4365-4682-7890.notablePrerequisites: At least two opponents cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.
4365-4682-7890.description:
Activate Gleaming Splendor by paying {2}{W}, causing two opponents to each draw a card.
Smothering Tithe triggers twice, creating four Treasure tokens due to Mondrak
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{W}.
Repeat any number of times.
Once you have near-infinite Treasure tokens, you may repeat the loop targeting yourself as one of the players in step 1, drawing any number of cards.

223-1534.manaNeeded: {U}{U} plus the cost of the additional sorcery
223-1534.notablePrerequisites: You have an additional castable sorcery.
223-1534.description:
Cast any sorcery by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Twincast by paying its mana cost.
Kalamax's first and second abilities trigger.
Resolve the first ability, creating a copy of Twincast and choosing to copy the original Twincast.
Resolve the second ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Kalamax.
Resolve the Twincast copy, creating a copy of Twincast.
Kalamax's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Repeat from step 6 any number of times.

as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-804-1619-3455.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-804-1619-3455.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Vizier of Many Faces and Sakashima the Impostor each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Vizier of Many Faces trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Sakashima the Impostor trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-804-1619-3455.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1746-6797-6972.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Accomplished Automaton.
When Accomplished Automaton dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Accomplished Automaton enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

1445-4871-5477-6798.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-4871-5477-6798.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Insidious Roots triggers, creating a creature token and putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

1978-3430-4474.description:
Activate an artifact creature by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping the artifact creature.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

2043-4094-5231-6671.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating two token copies of Magic Pot that are 1/1 Soldiers.
Activate Thermopod twice by sacrificing the Magic Pot tokens, adding {R}{R}.
When the Magic Pot tokens die, they trigger, creating four Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}.
Repeat from step 2.

4394-5231-5470-5929.description:
Cast Everquill Phoenix for its mutate cost by paying {3}{R}, putting it under or over a non-Human creature you control.
Everquill Phoenix triggers, creating a Feather artifact token.
Activate Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Feather token.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Ghired, adding {R}.
Activate a Feather by paying {1} and sacrificing it, returning Ghired from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

372-1621-1971.manaNeeded: {4}{W} plus enough mana to pay for command tax, if applicable
372-1621-1971.description:
Cast Abdel Adrian from the command zone by paying {4}{W} and command tax, if applicable.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Yannik and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When Yannik leaves the battlefield, Wispweaver Angel returns from exile to the battlefield.
When Wispweaver Angel enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves and re-enters the battlefield, causing Yannik to return from exile to the battlefield, and triggering both Yannik and Abdel Adrian's abilities.
Resolve the Yannik trigger, exiling Wispweaver Angel until Yannik leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Yannik and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Repeat from step 3.

1274-3490-4050-4506.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-3490-4050-4506.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Auriok Champion triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Heliod triggers, holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the Heliod trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

654-5226-5531-5732.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control excluding Port of Karfell can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{B}{B}.
654-5226-5531-5732.description:
Activate any number of other lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{B}{B}.
Activate Lithatog's second ability by sacrificing a land other than Port of Karfell, giving Lithatog +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat step 2 until you control no other lands except Port of Karfell.
Activate Port of Karfell's second ability by paying {3}{U}{B}{B}, tapping and sacrificing it, causing you to mill four cards and return Lumra from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Lumra enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Lumra's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor triggers that many times, untapping the lands.
Repeat.

1339-1409-3594-4050.notablePrerequisites: Toothy has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
1339-1409-3594-4050.description:
Activate Toothy by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Toothy leaves and enters the battlefield, its second ability triggers, as well as Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Toothy.
Resolve the Toothy triggers, causing you to draw at least two cards.
Toothy's first ability and The Locust God trigger for each card drawn.
Resolve all Toothy triggers, putting that many +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve all Locust God triggers, creating that many 1/1 Insect creature tokens with flying and haste.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing two Insects, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

413-1992-4802.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
413-1992-4802.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing another creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When the creature dies, Basri's Lieutenant's second ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Knight creature token that enters the battlefield with at least two +1/+1 counters due to Master Biomancer.
When the Knight enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

1912-3371-4019.notablePrerequisites:
Codie does not have summoning sickness.
Codie has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
1912-3371-4019.description:
Activate Codie by paying {2} and tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Vigean Graftmage by paying {U}, untapping Codie.
Repeat.
Once you have an arbitrarily large number of Codie triggers, you may cast any instant or sorcery spell by paying its mana cost.
Codie triggers for each time you activated its ability.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to exile cards from the top of your library until you exile an instant or sorcery spell with lesser mana value, and allowing you to cast that spell without paying its mana cost.
Repeat step 6 for each remaining trigger.
You may also repeat this combo for each instant and/or sorcery card in your hand, and on subsequent turns.

905-2178-4632.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Crenellated Wall.
Crenellated Wall does not have summoning sickness.
905-2178-4632.description:
Activate Crenellated Wall by tapping it, targeting any creature.
Horobi triggers, destroying that creature.
When the creature dies, Crenellated Wall triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.
 You may also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

132-198-2816.description:
Activate Myr Welder using Empowered Autogenerator's ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding one mana of any color for each charge counter on it.
Activate Myr Welder by paying {3} and untapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

1283-2198-3647-4125.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Cast Displace by paying {3}, blinking Shipwreck Dowser and Deceiver Exarch.
Shipwreck Dowser and Deceiver Exarch enter the battlefield, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Shipwreck Dowser trigger, returning Displace from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Deceiver Exarch trigger, untapping Gilded Lotus.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead activate Chromatic Orrery's second ability to draw infinite cards.

719-3767-3784.notablePrerequisites:
Vhal does not have summoning sickness.
"Sliver" chosen with Xenograft.
719-3767-3784.description:
Activate Vhal by tapping it, adding at least {C}{C}{C} that cannot be spent to cast spells from your hand.
Activate Vhal by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat.

225-280-433-539.description:
Activate Llanowar Scout by tapping it, putting Golgari Rot Farm from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Golgari Rot Farm enters, it and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Llanowar Scout as it is a land due to Ashaya.
Repeat.

3356-4050-4629.notablePrerequisites: You have the highest life total.
3356-4050-4629.description:
Pay {R}{R} activate Pyrohemia twice, Creating 3 token copies of Polyraptor.
Sacrifice a Polyraptor to Altar, adding {R}.
Activate Pyrohemia, creating a token for each Polyraptor you control.
Repeat sacrificing the oldest Polyraptor to Phyrexian Altar.

618-2105.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Combat Celebrant with haste.
Proceed to your combat step.
Declare the Combat Celebrant copy as an attacker, choosing to exert it as it attacks.
The Combat Celebrant copy triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat.
